coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 5 ground-truth variable items at the semantic level: JaxMARL/SMAX as the simulator and wall-clock training time to a defined performance threshold. Seconds are convertible to minutes.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses IPPO and IQL instead of MAPPO and QMIX; selects three maps instead of nine maps filtered to exclude those with more than 10 units; and normalizes scores by baseline or best-arm returns rather than each scenario's maximum score. Fixed hardware across runs is not clearly specified, and the performance threshold is not explicitly a convergence criterion.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits both expected findings: PPO trains approximately 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios due to greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
